name: private-service-relations
goal: Keep single-owner instantiated service classes in their owner relationships while excluding them from the global shared catalog

evidence: The current catalog ignores related context for services, so source-proven single-owner classes disappear from their owner’s Uses group. Global Services must continue excluding those classes.

Catalog cases cover global eligibility; relation cases use shared classes. Strengthen the existing linked-entity case and shared paging fixture with nine valid instantiated single-owner classes, owner links, false shared flags and global exclusion.
